drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 84-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.88, creatinine 1.08, hemoglobin 13.6, pao2 55, platelets 303, sodium 138, wbc 5.7; vitals dbp 78-82, heart_rate 73-77, map 95-99, o2_flow 0-40, resp_rate 27-32, sbp 128-132, spo2 87-94, temp 37-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; High-flow nasal cannula 40 L/min, FiO2 0.6
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.09, hemoglobin 13.6, platelets 307, sodium 138, wbc 5.5; vitals dbp 80-83, heart_rate 73-78, map 96-99, o2_flow 40, resp_rate 20-26, sbp 126-132, spo2 93-94, temp 37-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 84-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
